dict.string: Every download you start now stays in the Library, including ones that failed or that were cut short when the app stopped, and any of them can be tried again later. You can remove a single download or clear the list, and Remove on an installed title asks whether to move the copy to the Trash or only forget it here. An update you do not want can be ignored, and a new Settings window (in the application menu) can turn the Updates tab off altogether.
